tools.name: coverage
tools.description: List the states RestoSignals currently has data for and how many scored venues each holds (with a count of hot leads, opening_score >= 80). Call this FIRST to see live inventory before new_openings — querying a state with no data returns nothing. Free (0 credits) and needs no API key.

tools.name: new_openings
tools.description: Find restaurants/bars about to open in a state, ranked by opening_score (0-100). Fuses liquor licenses, food permits and new-business filings into one scored venue. signal_types on each lead are 'liquor', 'food_permit' and 'business'. tools.name: watch_area
tools.description: Register a webhook that fires when a new matching venue opens in an area. criteria = {state, city, signal_type, min_opening_score}. Paid accounts only.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_liquor_license" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
